title_en: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Offers a Callback to a Classic Iron Man Poster With a Close-Up of Doctor Doom's Mask
summary_en: Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster that gives us our closest look at Doctor Doom's mask yet.
body_en:
Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster that gives us our closest look at Doctor Doom's mask yet.
Robert Downey Jr.'s Victor von Doom debut is almost here. This new poster arrives hot on the heels of the movie's newest trailer , and while it focused on Steve Roger's (Chris Evans) role in the chaos, the poster gives one of the most iconic masks in comic book history the attention it deserves.
Considering all of the hubbub about Doctor Doom's different masks and costumes , it's nice to get a close-up of one of his most menacing looks and Downey Jr.'s dark green eye. You can see the full poster below.
Impressive details and rusty edges aside, many have also pointed out that there's more to this poster than meets the eye. No, there are no fun theories circulating about this one (yet), but it does continue to play into Downey Jr.'s ties to both Doctor Doom and his original Marvel Cinematic Universe hero, Iron Man.
One of the earliest MCU posters offered the same look at Iron Man's original Mark 3 design. Where Tony's poster gave audiences a new hero to take seriously, Doctor Doom's poster is more of a reminder of how far Marvel's heroes have come — and how far they still have to fall.
The reference is impossible to deny as fans continue to speculate how both of Downey Jr.'s characters may be connected. So far, Marvel has done its best to convince viewers that Doctor Doom is not a Tony Stark variant, but with posters like this only making the line between them darker, it's clear the MCU has more than a few fun surprises in store for next month.

Avengers: Doomsday premieres December 18, 2026. Despite keeping the fate of the Avengers, New Avengers, X-Men, and Fantastic Four a mystery, Marvel has drip-fed fans new information in the lead-up to launch. Last week, we got a look at a series of new, smaller posters , with an even earlier poster teasing Doctor Doom's Latverian witches . Just yesterday, Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld joined the cast .
For more, you can check out how Hot Toys revealed an alternate look at the MCU's new big bad . You can also see Downey Jr. tease more from the film with a new behind-the-scenes video .
